newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end higher after mixed session.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end higher after mixed session.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse ended higher on Thursday after Astra recovered early losses and debt yields fell.
The general market index rose 0.35 percent to 2,086.33 after turnover of 3.6 billion crowns.

Stena Line closed 2.20 crowns higher at 34.20 after news that it and Britain's P&O European Ferries would merge their short-sea ferry businesses on the English Channel into an operator with the same market share as the channel tunnel.
"A merged company like this is the best conceivable solution," one analyst said.
Drug company Astra edged up 0.50 crown to 289, off the day's low of 286. Telecoms group Ericsson rose one crown to 168.50.
The bank and insurance sector index fell. Dealers said it was a correction of the shares' recent gains, fuelled in part by merger rumours.
Handelsbanken fell 0.50 crown to 164.50 and Swedbank edged down 0.50 crown to 93.50.
Autoliv took back some of Wednesday's 14-crown fall and rose 5.50 crowns to 277.50.
The undertone is seen remaining positive, with shares mixed.
